name: Do I need to prime my bathroom walls before painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime my bathroom walls before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Priming bathroom walls is often a good idea, especially if you're painting over a darker color, dealing with stains, or painting new drywall. Primer helps paint adhere better, provides a uniform surface for the topcoat, and can improve the paint's durability and mildew resistance. If your walls are in good condition and you're using a paint-and-primer-in-one product, priming might not be strictly necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Priming bathroom walls is recommended for better paint adhesion, stain coverage, and durability, especially when changing colors or painting new drywall.
